description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the OpenmrsObjectSaveHandler class in the OpenMRS API. It tests handling of string properties with respect to annotations allowing empty strings and leading/trailing whitespace, using sample classes and the OpenmrsObjectSaveHandler's handle method.

classes.name: OpenmrsObjectSaveHandlerTest
classes.description: Test class for the OpenmrsObjectSaveHandler, containing multiple test cases for handling string properties and annotations.

classes.name: SomeClass
classes.description: Inner test class extending BaseOpenmrsObject, used for testing property handling with annotations.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetEmptyStringPropertiesToNull
methods.description: Tests that empty strings are set to null by the handler.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotSetEmptyStringPropertiesToNullForAllowEmptyStringsAnnotation
methods.description: Verifies that properties annotated with @AllowEmptyStrings are not nullified when empty.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotTrimEmptyStringsForAllowLeadingOrTrailingWhitespaceAnnotation
methods.description: Tests that properties with @AllowLeadingOrTrailingWhitespace are not trimmed.

methods.name: handle_shouldTrimStringsWithoutAllowLeadingOrTrailingWhitespaceAnnotation
methods.description: Checks that strings are trimmed when no whitespace annotation is present.

methods.name: handle_shouldTrimEmptyStringsForAllowEmptyStringsAnnotation
methods.description: Ensures that strings are trimmed for properties with @AllowEmptyStrings when applicable.
